correctness.rationale: For all 0<a<b, the proof derives the Fréchet derivative by Sylvester inversion, obtains a positive semigroup for the two-by-two Stieltjes orientation, and proves exactly that the input maximum-entry norm is attained by all-ones rank-one symmetric H and the larger diagonal row-square integral. The latter is monotone in the two spectral endpoints, and its scalar-angle derivative factors with a unique interior maximizer tanθ=√2−1. Convex-segment integration proves a global two-input bound; explicitly described admissible interior perturbations tend to equality at the endpoints. Symbolic derivative factorization was independently checked, and the included checker replayed 16,515 supplementary assertions. Numerics are not the proof; strict a,b and dimension two delimit all claims.
